evidence.notes: Database.executeBatch lifecycle exercises start/execute/finish with BatchableContext.getJobId().
BatchableContext.getJobId() returns a deterministic local job ID while processing a batch.

source.content: global class SimpleBatch implements Database.Batchable<SObject> { global Iterable<SObject> start(Database.BatchableContext bc) { return Database.getQueryLocator('SELECT Id, Name FROM Account LIMIT 10'); } global void execute(Database.BatchableContext bc, List<SObject> scope) { } global void finish(Database.BatchableContext bc) { } }

@isTest private class CoreRuntimeDatabaseBatchableLifecycleTest { @isTest static void batchLifecycleWithContext() { SimpleBatch batch = new SimpleBatch(); System.assertNotEquals(null, batch); Test.startTest(); Id jobId = Database.executeBatch(batch, 200); System.assertNotEquals(null, jobId); Test.stopTest(); } }
